target: Supabase project comms-hub (one transaction, rolled back)
migrationNote: Applied to comms-hub the same day, in that order. The statements are those of the files; comment lines were left out of the applied text for the first one and 140100 was applied as two statements (the new function, then create or replace of storage_move_claim).
attempts: Run 1: 75 of 95 by the script's own count, with 3 failures listed (24, 66, 88) and 17 checks that returned null. Cause: the harness, not the product. storage_moves, storage_move_items and file_locations have row level security and no policy (by design), so a check that read them as the signed-in role saw no rows. The checks now read them through pg_temp.q, a security-definer reader, and every action still runs as the person.

Run 2: the plan's approved flag and the way back were found correct by hand (a diagnostic in a rolled-back transaction); the same cause. The final select was also changed from '=' to 'is not distinct from', because a null result had been excluded from the failure list and counted as not passed.

Between runs the review of the script found a real defect: a prefix of ../x passed the pattern, and a dot segment in an object key is collapsed by URL handling. Migration 20261015140300 refuses a '.' or '..' segment in a prefix and in the address path; checks 11 and 11b cover it.
advisors: Security advisors read after the migrations: the lint groups are unchanged in kind (RLS enabled with no policy: storage_moves and storage_move_items join the earlier internal tables; anon-callable security-definer functions: three more, all gated by the server key: storage_serving, int_secret_use_id, storage_provider_health; signed-in-callable: the new session functions, the product's API; leaked-password protection still off). No error-level finding.
